label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: A country selector overlay covered the whole page after declining cookies, with no close button and Escape did nothing, so no product could be clicked until I found the right duplicate region link.
The same region links appear twice in the overlay with identical names, and the first match was covered, so it was unclear which one to use.

Main menu links have no names of their own, only a nested navigation element with the text [name] or MENS, and many links and the header cart-adjacent links are unnamed, so I could not tell where they lead.

After pressing Add to bag nothing in the tree confirmed it; the cart still read Cart 0 and the cart drawer only showed up later, so I could not tell if the item was added. Size links xs to xl and the icon-only buttons next to Add to bag have no clear names or selected state.
The cart link was reported as covered by a paragraph element while the drawer was open, and the drawer content sits at the end of the page tree, outside the main landmarks.
